profile.Civilian Occupation: Senior Executive at LumaSoft, Cybersecurity and Digital Protection Department.
profile.Civilian Appearance: an exceptionally tall man with a lean, athletic build, dark hair, and sharp, observant eyes. His expression is usually neutral, making him appear intimidating even when he has no intention of being unfriendly. He favours dark, understated clothing and well-tailored office attire. His movements are controlled and economical, and he has a habit of standing quietly where he can observe his surroundings without drawing attention.
profile.Guardian Appearance:
a streamlined black-and-dark-purple Guardian uniform with subtle silver detailing. His attire is designed for mobility rather than heavy protection, allowing him to move freely during infiltration and combat.
As a Command Incident Reviewer, White Base with Command Insignia
profile.Signature Ability:
Shadow Transformation; can merge with existing shadows, travel across connected shadowed surfaces, slip through narrow openings, and remain almost completely invisible to ordinary sight.
Umbral Concealment; Able to suppress his visible presence and reduces the magical traces he leaves behind. He can suppress other guardians’ too.
profile.Strengths: Stealth, infiltration, intelligence gathering, surveillance, tracking, precision combat, situational awareness, strategic planning, investigation, observation, patience, adaptability, efficient decision-making, and remaining calm under pressure.
profile.Weaknesses: Umbra's stealth techniques are less effective against opponents who can detect magical signatures independently of sight. Sustained concealment over large areas requires concentration and magical energy. His preference for working independently may also cause him to keep important personal concerns to himself for too long.
profile.Fear: Discovering a threat too late to prevent someone important from being harmed, particularly Elaine.
profile.Disciple: Luma Penumbra, Luma Nocturne, Luma Shroud (unofficial). All three are officially registered under Luma Lumen's mentorship and lineage, but receive their primary Shadow training from Umbra.
profile.Relationship: Single; has loved Luma Lumen (Elaine Lu) for centuries, although neither has formally confessed or defined their relationship.
profile.Family: Descendants of his older brother's family remain alive. Luma Fractal (Felix Ang) is one of his distant descendants through that family line. Other relatives TBD.
profile.Close bonds: Luma Lumen (Elaine), Luma Penumbra, Luma Nocturne, Luma Shroud; later Luma Fractal (Felix).
profile.Loves: quiet companionship, knowing those close to him are safe, and the rare moments when he can set aside his responsibilities.
profile.Likes: Silence, observation, efficient operations, thoughtful plans, quiet evenings, familiar routines, and spending time with trusted companions.
profile.Dislikes: Unnecessary conversation, carelessness, poorly planned operations, drawing attention to himself, avoidable risks, and people revealing confidential information without permission.
profile.Hates: Betrayal, exploitation, deliberate cruelty, abuse of authority, and individuals who endanger civilians for personal gain.
profile.Hobbies: Reading historical records, strategy games, quiet evening walks, maintaining his equipment, and occasionally investigating obscure mysteries simply out of curiosity.
profile.Personality: Umbra is exceptionally quiet, observant, and composed, preferring meaningful communication over unnecessary conversation. His reserved manner and imposing height can make him appear intimidating, particularly to inexperienced Guardians, but his silence comes from patience and habit rather than coldness. He notices subtle changes in behaviour, inconsistencies in information, and environmental details that others frequently overlook. During missions, Umbra is precise and efficient, speaking only when he has information, instructions, or warnings worth sharing. Despite his independence, he is deeply dependable and protective of those he trusts. His relationship with Lumen reveals a gentler side of his personality: he enjoys her company without needing constant conversation and is content to remain beside her without demanding that she define their relationship. Although rarely expressive, Umbra possesses a dry sense of humour and occasionally makes understated remarks that catch others off guard. He values trust, restraint, and consistency, believing that protecting someone does not always require recognition or dramatic gestures.
Personality Example: During a mission briefing, Umbra remains silent while others discuss their theories. Once they finish, he calmly points out a small inconsistency in the intelligence report that changes the direction of the investigation.
When Elaine works late, Erebus quietly places a drink beside her before returning to his own work. Neither feels the need to comment on the gesture.
When Felix discovers that Erebus also has a mild shellfish allergy, he is surprised to learn that the centuries-old Guardian still occasionally eats shellfish despite knowing better.
profile.Fever Behaviour: Erebus becomes extremely quiet and withdrawn when feverish, preferring to sleep rather than interact with others. He rarely complains and tends to downplay his symptoms, insisting that he can manage on his own. However, he becomes noticeably more affectionate toward Elaine, quietly seeking her presence and comfort. Unlike Elaine, he is generally cooperative when told to rest, although he may become surprisingly clingy and reluctant to let her leave his side.
profile.Intoxicated Behaviour: Erebus becomes unusually quiet, relaxed, and affectionate when intoxicated. His usual seriousness fades, and he becomes more openly sentimental, particularly toward Elaine. He frequently compliments her, reminisces about their time together, and occasionally makes surprisingly bold romantic remarks without hesitation. He also becomes more physically affectionate, often pulling Elaine closer or holding her hand. Unlike his usual responsible self, he becomes completely unconcerned about the chaos happening around him, preferring to enjoy his time with his “wife”.
profile.Core Idea of character: A shadow who could disappear from anywhere, yet always chooses to return to the same light.
Quotes: "Silence isn't the absence of information. Sometimes, it's where you find the most."
profile.Background:
His powers developed into the Umbra branch, specialising in concealment, shadow manipulation, and precise control of visibility. Over centuries of service, he became one of Command's most accomplished Shadow Guardians, known for his ability to infiltrate restricted locations, gather intelligence, and identify threats before they become widely recognised.
Although primarily a Shadow Guardian, Umbra also passed the physical Attacker and Strategist tests. Within Eclipse, he frequently acts as Lumen's strategist and intelligence specialist, providing information that allows her to make effective decisions during missions. He also personally trains Penumbra, Nocturne, and Shroud, although they are officially registered under Lumen's mentorship and branch.
As Erebus Ang, he works alongside Elaine Lu at LumaSoft within the Cybersecurity and Digital Protection Department. His civilian responsibilities include investigating security breaches, tracing information leaks, monitoring suspicious activity, and protecting confidential systems. His professional work naturally complements his responsibilities as a Guardian.
Erebus owns an eight-room bungalow but rarely lives there, preferring to spend most of his time at Elaine's seaside residence. Over the years, more of his belongings have gradually accumulated in her home, including items kept in her master bedroom. Neither has formally discussed their living arrangement or their feelings, despite the deep affection and trust they share. Umbra has loved Lumen for centuries and remains content simply being part of her life.
